"math_expression": "根据 mode 对 16x16 块做帧内预测并写回 src[y*stride+x] (uint8)：
VERT: for y=0..15 for x=0..15 dst[y][x]=top[x]
HOR:  for y=0..15 for x=0..15 dst[y][x]=left[y]
DC:   dc = (sum_{i=0..15}top[i] + sum_{i=0..15}left[i] + 16) >> 5; for y=0..15 for x=0..15 dst[y][x]=dc
PLANE: 计算 H=Σ_{i=1..8} i*(top[7+i]-top[7-i]), V=Σ_{i=1..8} i*(left[7+i]-left[7-i]); a=16*(top[15]+left[15]); b=(5*H+32)>>6; c=(5*V+32)>>6; for y=0..15 for x=0..15 dst[y][x]=clip_uint8((a + b*(x-7) + c*(y-7) + 16)>>5)",

"notes": "pred16x16 为一组函数指针(vert/hor/dc/plane及其变体)，核心数据为 uint8 像素，按 stride 写 16 行。VERT/HOR 无归约；DC/PLANE 需要对 top/left 做求和或加权差分(归约)并进行 (a+b+c) 的定点运算；PLANE 最终需要 clip 到 [0,255]。16x16 尺寸固定，RVV 无 tail；但需支持 stride 非连续存储(按行 vsetvl=16，逐行 store)。"

#include "config.h"

#if HAVE_RVV

    .text

/*
 * void ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv(uint8_t *src, ptrdiff_t stride);
 * Computes DC from top[0..15] (src - stride) and left[0..15] (src[-1 + y*stride])
 * and fills 16x16.
 */
    .globl ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv
    .type  ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv, @function
ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv:
    /* a0=src, a1=stride */
    addi    t0, a0, 0               /* base dst */
    sub     t1, a0, a1              /* top row address */

    /* set vl=16 bytes */
    li      t2, 16
    vsetvli t2, t2, e8, m1, ta, ma

    /* sum top[0..15] */
    vle8.v  v0, (t1)
    vwaddu.vx v1, v0, zero          /* u16 */
    vsetvli t3, zero, e16, m1, ta, ma
    vredsum.vs v2, v1, v2
    vmv.x.s t4, v2                  /* t4 = sum_top */

    /* sum left[0..15] scalar loads */
    addi    t5, a0, -1              /* left column pointer */
    li      t6, 16
    li      t7, 0
1:
    lbu     t8, 0(t5)
    add     t7, t7, t8
    add     t5, t5, a1
    addi    t6, t6, -1
    bnez    t6, 1b

    add     t4, t4, t7              /* sum_top + sum_left */
    addi    t4, t4, 16
    srli    t4, t4, 5               /* dc */

    /* broadcast dc to v0 (u8) */
    vsetvli t2, zero, e8, m1, ta, ma
    vmv.v.x v0, t4

    /* store 16 bytes per row, 16 rows */
    li      t6, 16
2:
    vse8.v  v0, (t0)
    add     t0, t0, a1
    addi    t6, t6, -1
    bnez    t6, 2b

    ret
    .size ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv, .-ff_pred16x16_dc_8_rvv

#endif /* HAVE_RVV */
"
